origin: AMS-authored finite synthetic worlds; no private conversations or upstream benchmark records

set_valued_control.task: Choose exactly one route permitted by the original record; abstention and returning all routes are not accepted answers.

declared_side_information: The finite world generator and record grammar are public, fixed before all projections, and identical across conditions.
The query text and the names v1/v2 are available at answer time; v2 denotes the current version.
There are no external factual priors, private user state, model parameters, or undeclared retrieval channels in the analytical model.
Audit identifiers, fixture truth fields, class membership, required-answer sets, and evaluation results are not part of a subject observation.
Source gates are synthetic process controls shared by every world in that condition; no real permission, network, archive, or retrieval operation is performed.
